title: [FLINK-40166][table] SQL query parsing fails if current catalog unreachable
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

If the current catalog is unreachable, any SQL query fails to parse - even queries that make fully-qualified accesses to catalogs that are reachable.

This is because we make a call to databaseExists in the current catalog as part of parsing the statement.

## Brief change log

This commit wraps the call to databaseExists in a try..catch so it doesn't block the remainder of the parsing.

## Verifying this change
